statement.p: Suppose you wanted to draw a quadrilateral using the dots below as vertices (corners). The dots are spaced one unit apart horizontally and two units apart vertically.
How many quadrilaterals are possible? quadrilaterals.
How many are trapezoids? (Here, as is calculus, a trapezoid is defined as a quadrilateral with at least one pair of parallel sides. In particular, parallelograms are trapezoids.) trapezoids.
How many are trapezoids that are not paralleograms?
